# Online Compass

> > A collection of browser-based navigation and measurement tools including compass, speedometer, bubble level, and qibla finder accessible across multiple languages and devices.

Online Compass provides free, in-browser tools for direction finding and navigation without requiring installation or permissions beyond device sensors. The platform supports 15+ languages and works across all major browsers (Chrome, Safari, Edge) and mobile platforms (iOS, Android).

## Key Topics

- Device Orientation
- Browser-based Tools
- GPS Navigation
- Magnetometer
- Mobile Sensors
- Offline-capable
- Direction Finding
- Compass Tool
- Qibla Finder
- Speedometer
- Bubble Level
- Cross-platform
- Generic Sensor API
- Real-time Measurement

## Core Navigation Tools

- [Online Compass](https://onlinecompass.io): Main homepage for Online Compass browser-based navigation tool
- [Online Qibla Finder](https://onlinecompass.io/qibla-finder): Qibla direction finder using GPS and device orientation
- [Online Speedometer](https://onlinecompass.io/speedometer): GPS-based speedometer tool for accurate speed measurement
- [Online Bubble Level](https://onlinecompass.io/bubble-level): Online bubble level tool for checking horizontal/vertical alignment
